conditions.label: Congenital cytomegalovirus infection
conditions.note: Pregnancy delivered; infant's congenital CMV followed by pediatrics and pediatric ID

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
F/u BP and iron, 14 wks postpartum.

Doing much better. Baby home since late Nov, followed by pediatrics and peds ID. Still nursing/pumping. Sleep improving. Back and pelvic pain gone since delivery.
Stopped checking BP at home after OB visit, last readings all 110s-120s/70s.
Taking FeSO4 daily and PNV. No ibuprofen in weeks.
OB 12/2 postpartum note reviewed: normal recovery, BP 122/78.

PHQ-9 4 (was 7 in Oct).

Exam: BP 116/74, repeat 114/74. Well appearing. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. No edema.

A/P:
1. Gestational hypertension - resolved, normal BP off meds well past 12 wks. With GHTN and dad's HTN she has a higher lifetime risk; BP check at least yearly with us.
2. Pelvic girdle pain of pregnancy - resolved.
3. CMV in pregnancy - pregnancy over, closing on her list; baby's care is with pediatrics.
4. Iron deficiency anemia - Hgb 11.6, ferritin 12 in Dec. Continue FeSO4 daily. Recheck CBC/iron mid-March.
5. Mood - improved, PHQ-9 4.

Physical in the summer.

documents.title: March labs
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Your labs from Tuesday: hemoglobin 12.4, now in the normal range. Ferritin up to 24 from 12 - better, but stores aren't full yet. Stay on the iron daily and we'll look again at your physical this summer.

documents.title: Appointment cancelled
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Pt called to cancel tomorrow's check-in - nothing new, labs were fine and she'd rather keep the afternoon free. Will see PCP for physical in August. Booked 8/18 at 3:40.

documents.title: Iron refill
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Pharmacy says the iron is out of refills. Can you renew it until my physical in August?

documents.title: Refill sent
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Ferrous sulfate 325 mg daily #90, 0 refills sent per PCP (to last until 8/18 physical). Pt notified.

documents.title: Vaccines while nursing
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Is it fine to get the flu and covid shots this fall while I'm still nursing? Want to plan ahead before school starts.

documents.title: RE: Vaccines while nursing
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Yes - both are recommended while breastfeeding, and some of the antibodies even pass to the baby through milk. We'll get them on the calendar at your physical in August.

conditions.label: Iron deficiency anemia
conditions.note: Hemoglobin and ferritin normal; iron stopped

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
ANNUAL PREVENTIVE VISIT

31 y/o elementary school teacher, ~10 months postpartum. Still nursing once or twice a day. Feels well. Baby followed closely by pediatrics/peds ID.

Interval: no illnesses, no ED visits. BP normal at January visit. On FeSO4 325 daily and PNV.

PMH: IDA (on iron), hx GHTN 2025 (resolved), hx cholelithiasis (asymptomatic). OB 2025: previa bleed, PPROM with intra-amniotic infection, preterm SVD 32 wks; baby with congenital CMV.
Meds: FeSO4 325 daily, PNV daily. NKDA.
FH: mother preeclampsia, father HTN. SH: never smoker, no alcohol currently.

ROS negative.
PHQ-9 2.

Exam: BP 114/72, other vitals as charted. Well appearing. HEENT normal. Neck supple, thyroid normal. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, non-tender, no RUQ tenderness. Skin without concerning lesions. Ext no edema.

Health maintenance:
- Cervical: Pap/HPV cotest negative 4/2025 at OB; next due 2030. GYN with OB yearly.
- Vaccines: Tdap 9/2025. Flu and COVID due this fall - booked flu nurse visit.
- HIV, hep C screens negative in 2025 prenatal labs.
- Lipids today (GHTN history).

A/P:
1. Iron deficiency anemia - labs today; if ferritin is in range, stop iron.
2. Hx gestational HTN - BP normal; yearly checks.
3. Lactating - continue PNV while nursing.
4. Preventive as above.

RTC 1 year, flu shot in Sept.

documents.title: Physical labs
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Rachel - all good news. Hemoglobin 12.9 and ferritin 38, so your iron stores are back where they should be. You can stop the ferrous sulfate. Keep the prenatal vitamin while you're nursing. Cholesterol panel is normal. See you for the flu shot in September.
